title: Measure useful-answer/artifact quality, latency/error budgets and cost per completed task including failed attempts, storage/egress, support and operations. Apply enforced spend admission, not alerts alone.
scope: Engineering half delivered end-to-end: enforced spend admission (product gate, fail-closed, typed 503) + per-completed-task economics model (failed attempts charged but never completed; storage/egress/support/ops attribution; latency/error budgets; pinned-quality provenance). Hosted provider cost figures, calibrated human review, real outage/latency telemetry and merchant/GA acceptance recorded as external gates per the BILL-01 local-maximum doctrine.
laws: enforced spend admission: a configured spend cap must actually refuse (typed 503), never alert alone; enforcement is explicit opt-in, and a misconfigured cap while enabled is itself a refusal, never 'no limit'
byte-identical when off: with no BILLING_SPEND_ADMISSION=enabled the gate records nothing and the existing test-mode runtime is unchanged (legacy billing 22/22)
unit-economics denominator is completed tasks only: a failed attempt charges provider cost but is never a completed task
attribution is explicit: provider, storage, retained-inactive storage (D-090 retention is not deletion), egress, support and operations each appear as a separate line
latency budgets measured: observed whole-op/backend p95 vs the documented 20s/18s envelopes (provider <=14s recorded); outside-budget marked
error budget: failure share vs the 99.9% objective (43.2 minutes/month), reported as steering, not an invented hosted outage figure
quality is only measured with pinned rubric/source/model versions (D-084); independent held-out review marks distribution vs assumption
beta provenance fail-closed: a capture.source='beta' claim without windowStart/windowEnd/activeUsers/daysCaptured is refused (mirrors RELEASE-01 workload-model)

preExistingDefectFixed.finding: hardcoded injected clock at = 2026-11-02T00:00Z; 7-day default expiry (2026-11-09T00:00Z) becomes strictly past vs real DB clock_timestamp on and after 2026-11-09, so every default invite threw InvitationPolicyError('expired') — 22/37 data-04 tests failed, reproduced byte-identically on pristine dev and identical to the fix already recorded on the BILL-06 branch (61ecc15e), which is not yet in dev
preExistingDefectFixed.fix: rolling per-run base Date.now() - 1 day, preserving the suite's own at+7d > now > at invariant deterministically within a run; test-fixture only, separate commit, no product/assertion change

defectsFoundAndFixed.finding: float precision on 43.2 minutes (43.20000000000004) and p95 expectation mismatch — first two drafts asserted exact equality
defectsFoundAndFixed.fix: tolerance assertion and p95 = smallest bucket whose cumulative share reaches 0.95
